raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw `amount` values carry a '$' prefix (e.g. '$75.13' in batch 12), which DuckDB cannot cast directly to DECIMAL(12,2). Currency is always USD, so stripping the '$' (and any thousands commas) before the cast preserves the amounts without changing any values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(amount), '[$,]', '', 'g') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
